"Create a 2d pixel Pokémon game mirroring pokemon yellow version on gameboy color. You play as a team rocket grunt in a run down base who works his way through the ranks. People have stats like pokemon and can fight trainers as well as steal pokemon. As you progress you unlock upgrades for your character and improve your base.  As a grunt you can work and manage the game corner which contains a functional slot machine game playable as a grunt. The slot machine should payout credits used to buy upgrades for the entire pokemon game. As you rank up you unlock ways to improve the probability of higher payouts, payout size and get better prizes to buy when redeeming credits. You can work at the Pokémon daycare which doubles as an unground Pokémon breeding and fusion laboratory with a secret fighting club tournament were tiers are unlocked as you progress the story. You unlock access to the fusion lab as you rank up. Ranking up requires pokemon collection, taking over pokemon gyms and progression into controlling towns. There needs to be a rival protagonist who's story progresses as we rank up. There needs to be a rival within team rocket trying to be better than us. When you reach boss rank you can fight the elite 4 and corrupt the entire pokemon league. Reaching boss rank unlocks advanced organization management and the ability to further develope team rocket

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable browser-based pixel RPG about a Team Rocket-style grunt climbing the ranks, managing a base, and eventually taking over the Pokémon League.
- User asked to build now without clarification and requested small JPEG screenshots for checks.

## Requirements
- Classic handheld pixel-RPG inspiration; player fights trainers, collects creatures, takes gyms/towns, upgrades character and base.
- Include a playable slot machine with credits used for game-wide upgrades and improved odds/payouts/prizes.
- Include daycare, rank-gated fusion lab, and unlockable underground fighting club.
- Include a rival protagonist whose story progresses with the player and an internal Rocket rival.
- Boss rank unlocks Elite Four/League takeover and organization management.
- Finish with brief reasonable assumptions noted.

## Decisions
- Assistant chose an original setting, characters, and creatures rather than reusing Pokémon proprietary characters/assets.
- Built as a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with localStorage persistence.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created introductory game screen, initial creature selection, persistent state scaffolding, HUD/navigation, and base/field/corner/lab views in progress.
- Added pixel-art canvas renderers for the hideout and city map.
- Added slot-machine gameplay, prize shop, credits, and several permanent upgrades.
- Added field mission cards, battle modal/turn logic, creature recruitment, rank promotion logic, daycare healing, club, and fusion interface.

### Active
- Finish the remaining game systems and event wiring; the `game.js` implementation is incomplete.
- Validate gameplay, syntax, responsive presentation, and persistence; capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

Core:
  open [url]                  open the browser

  detach                      detach from an attached browser
  goto <url>                  navigate to a url

  uncheck <target>            uncheck a checkbox or radio button
  snapshot [target]           capture page snapshot to obtain element ref
  find [text]                 search the page snapshot for text or a regexp, returning matching nodes with surrounding context (like search snippets)
  eval <func> [target]        evaluate javascript expression on page or element
  dialog-accept [prompt]      accept a dialog
  dialog-dismiss              dismiss a dialog
  resize <w> <h>              resize the browser window
  delete-data                 delete session data

Navigation:
  go-back                     go back to the previous page
  go-forward                  go forward to the next page
  reload                      reload the current page

  keyup <key>                 press a key up on the keyboard

Mouse:
  mousemove <x> <y>           move mouse to a given position

Save as:

  tab-list                    list all tabs

  tab-close [index]           close a browser tab
  tab-select <index>          select a browser tab

Storage:
  state-load <filename>       loads browser storage (authentication) state from a file
  state-save [filename]       saves the current storage (authentication) state to a file
  cookie-list                 list all cookies (optionally filtered by domain/path)
  cookie-get <name>           get a specific cookie by name
  cookie-set <name> <value>   set a cookie with optional flags
  cookie-delete <name>        delete a specific cookie
  cookie-clear                clear all cookies
  localstorage-list           list all localstorage key-value pairs

  route-list                  list all active network routes

  recording-stop              stop recording user actions and print them as playwright code

## Objective
- Complete and validate a playable browser-based pixel RPG about an original syndicate grunt rising through the ranks and taking over the League.

## Requirements
- Include classic handheld-RPG-inspired battles, original creatures and characters, recruitment, gyms/towns, upgrades, rivals, and localStorage saves.
- Include playable slots, prizes and game-wide upgrades, daycare, rank-gated fusion, a fighting club, and Boss-rank organization/League management.
- Capture and inspect a JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px; briefly note reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Use a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with `neon-syndicate-save` as its localStorage key.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the game shell, responsive styling, intro and starter selection, campaign progression, battles, recruitment, upgrades, slots, daycare, fusion, fighting club, League UI, and organization controls.
- Fixed League progression to finish after four matches and separated the neighborhood-front upgrade from the Game Corner slot-tuner upgrade.
- `node --check game.js` passed after the fixes.

### Active
- Validate gameplay, persistence, and responsive presentation in a browser; address any issues found.
- Capture and inspect the requested JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Open the running app and test the intro, campaign progression, slots/upgrades, daycare/fusion/club, League matches, and organization controls.
2. Check localStorage save/load and responsive layout; fix any issues.
3. Capture and inspect a JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px.
4. Summarize completion and note reasonable assumptions briefly.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, campaign, League, organization management, and initialization.
- `index.html`: App shell and interactive UI roots.
- `style.css`: Responsive game interface styling.
- `start.sh`: Starts the app using the configured runtime.
- `capture.sh`: Invokes the configured capture script.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files are untracked.
- League unlock requires Boss rank and three controlled towns.
- `renderOrganization()` remains unused.
- The app was launched with `./start.sh`; browser validation and screenshot capture are not yet confirmed.

## Objective
- Complete and validate a playable browser-based pixel RPG about an original syndicate grunt rising through the ranks and taking over the League.

## Requirements
- Include classic handheld-RPG-inspired battles, original creatures and characters, recruitment, gyms/towns, upgrades, rivals, and localStorage saves.
- Include playable slots, prizes and game-wide upgrades, daycare, rank-gated fusion, a fighting club, and Boss-rank organization/League management.
- Capture and inspect a JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px; briefly note reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Use a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with `neon-syndicate-save` as its localStorage key.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the game shell, responsive styling, intro and starter selection, campaign progression, battles, recruitment, upgrades, slots, daycare, fusion, fighting club, League UI, and organization controls.
- Fixed League progression to finish after four matches and separated the neighborhood-front upgrade from the Game Corner slot-tuner upgrade.
- `node --check game.js` passed after those fixes.
- Started the app at `http://127.0.0.1:3000`, opened it in Playwright, and checked the intro, starter selection, and start of gameplay.
- Fixed capture battles so successfully catching Craglet no longer ends the fight prematurely.

### Active
- Continue validating gameplay, persistence, and responsive presentation; address any issues found.
- Capture and inspect the requested JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue browser checks for campaign progression, slots/upgrades, daycare/fusion/club, League matches, and organization controls.
2. Check localStorage save/load and responsive layout; fix any issues.
3. Capture and inspect a JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px.
4. Summarize completion and note reasonable assumptions briefly.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, campaign, League, organization management, and initialization.
- `index.html`: App shell and interactive UI roots.
- `style.css`: Responsive game interface styling.
- `start.sh`: Starts the app using the configured runtime.
- `capture.sh`: Invokes the configured capture script.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files are untracked.
- Browser opened at `http://127.0.0.1:3000`; intro and starter choice were verified, then gameplay was checked with Emberkit recruited.
- Browser logged a 404 for `http://127.0.0.1:3000/favicon.ico`.
- `renderOrganization()` remains unused.

## Objective
- Complete and validate a playable browser-based pixel RPG about an original syndicate grunt rising through the ranks and taking over the League.

## Requirements
- Include classic handheld-RPG-inspired battles, original creatures and characters, recruitment, gyms/towns, upgrades, rivals, and localStorage saves.
- Include playable slots, prizes and game-wide upgrades, daycare, rank-gated fusion, a fighting club, and Boss-rank organization/League management.
- Capture and inspect a JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px; briefly note reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Use a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with `neon-syndicate-save` as its localStorage key.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the game shell, responsive styling, intro and starter selection, campaign progression, battles, recruitment, upgrades, slots, daycare, fusion, fighting club, League UI, and organization controls.
- Fixed League progression to finish after four matches and separated the neighborhood-front upgrade from the Game Corner slot-tuner upgrade.
- Fixed capture battles so successfully catching Craglet no longer ends the fight prematurely.
- `node --check game.js` passed; browser checks confirmed the intro, starter selection, and base gameplay render.

### Active
- Validate campaign progression, features, save/load, and responsive presentation; fix any issues found.
- Capture and inspect a JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue browser checks for campaign progression, slots/upgrades, daycare/fusion/club, League matches, and organization controls.
2. Check localStorage save/load and responsive layout; fix any issues.
3. Capture and inspect the requested JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px.
4. Summarize completion and note reasonable assumptions briefly.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, campaign, League, organization management, and initialization.
- `index.html`: App shell and interactive UI roots.
- `style.css`: Responsive game interface styling.
- `start.sh`: Starts the app using the configured runtime.
- `capture.sh`: Invokes the configured capture script.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files are untracked.
- Browser is open at `http://127.0.0.1:3000/`; the starter was selected and base gameplay with Emberkit was checked.
- Browser logged a 404 for `http://127.0.0.1:3000/favicon.ico`.
- `renderOrganization()` remains unused.

## Objective
- Complete and validate a playable browser-based pixel RPG about an original syndicate grunt rising through the ranks and taking over the League.

## Requirements
- Include classic handheld-RPG-inspired battles, original creatures and characters, recruitment, gyms/towns, upgrades, rivals, and localStorage saves.
- Include playable slots, prizes and game-wide upgrades, daycare, rank-gated fusion, a fighting club, and Boss-rank organization/League management.
- Captured Pokémon must be usable in battles.
- Capture and inspect a JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px; briefly note reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Use a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with `neon-syndicate-save` as its localStorage key.
- Switching creatures uses the player’s turn; when a creature faints, the next healthy team member takes over automatically.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the game shell, responsive styling, intro and starter selection, campaign progression, battles, recruitment, upgrades, slots, daycare, fusion, fighting club, League UI, and organization controls.
- Fixed League progression to finish after four matches and separated the neighborhood-front upgrade from the Game Corner slot-tuner upgrade.
- Fixed capture battles so successfully catching Craglet no longer ends the fight prematurely.
- Added battle creature switching and automatic switch-on-faint so recruited creatures can fight.
- `node --check game.js` passed; browser checks confirmed the intro, starter selection, and base gameplay render.

### Active
- Validate campaign progression, battle creature switching, features, save/load, and responsive presentation; fix any issues found.
- Capture and inspect a JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Test battle switching and automatic replacement after a knockout.
2. Continue checks for campaign progression, slots/upgrades, daycare/fusion/club, League matches, organization controls, localStorage save/load, and responsive layout.
3. Capture and inspect the requested JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px.
4. Summarize completion and note reasonable assumptions briefly.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, campaign, battles, creature roster and switching, League, organization management, and initialization.
- `index.html`: App shell and interactive UI roots.
- `style.css`: Responsive game interface styling.
- `capture.sh`: Invokes the configured capture script.
- `start.sh`: Starts the app using the configured runtime.

- Changes are uncommitted; project files are untracked.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete and validate a playable browser-based pixel RPG about an original syndicate grunt rising through the ranks and taking over the League.

## Requirements
- Include classic handheld-RPG-inspired battles, original creatures and characters, recruitment, gyms/towns, upgrades, rivals, and localStorage saves.
- Include playable slots, prizes and game-wide upgrades, daycare, rank-gated fusion, a fighting club, and Boss-rank organization/League management.
- Captured Pokémon must be usable in battles.
- Capture and inspect a JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px; briefly note reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Use a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with `neon-syndicate-save` as its localStorage key.
- Switching creatures uses the player’s turn; when a creature faints, the next healthy team member takes over automatically.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the game shell, responsive styling, intro and starter selection, campaign progression, battles, recruitment, upgrades, slots, daycare, fusion, fighting club, League UI, and organization controls.
- Fixed League progression to finish after four matches and separated the neighborhood-front upgrade from the Game Corner slot-tuner upgrade.
- Fixed capture battles so successfully catching Craglet no longer ends the fight prematurely.
- Added battle creature switching and automatic switch-on-faint so recruited creatures can fight.
- `node --check game.js` passed; browser snapshot confirmed the starter-selected base gameplay interface renders.

### Active
- Validate battle switching/replacement, campaign progression, other game features, save/load, and responsive presentation.
- Capture and inspect the requested JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Test manual creature switching and automatic replacement after a knockout.
2. Continue validating campaign progression, slots/upgrades, daycare/fusion/club, League matches, organization controls, localStorage save/load, and responsive layout.
3. Capture and inspect a JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px.
4. Summarize completion and briefly note reasonable assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, campaign, battles, creature roster and switching, League, organization management, and initialization.
- `index.html`: App shell and interactive UI roots.
- `style.css`: Responsive game interface styling.
- `capture.sh`: Invokes the configured capture script.
- `start.sh`: Starts the app using the configured runtime.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files are untracked.
- Browser is at `http://127.0.0.1:3000/`; a starter was selected and base gameplay with Emberkit was checked.
- `playwright-cli snapshot` showed the gameplay interface; `node --check game.js` passed.
- Browser previously logged a 404 for `http://127.0.0.1:3000/favicon.ico`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete and validate a playable browser-based pixel RPG about an original syndicate grunt rising through the ranks and taking over the League.

## Requirements
- Include classic handheld-RPG-inspired battles, original creatures and characters, recruitment, gyms/towns, upgrades, rivals, and localStorage saves.
- Include playable slots, prizes and game-wide upgrades, daycare, rank-gated fusion, a fighting club, and Boss-rank organization/League management.
- Captured creatures must be usable in battles.
- Capture and inspect a JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px; briefly note reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Use a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with `neon-syndicate-save` as its localStorage key.
- Switching creatures uses the player’s turn; when a creature faints, the next healthy team member takes over automatically.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the game shell, responsive styling, intro and starter selection, campaign progression, battles, recruitment, upgrades, slots, daycare, fusion, fighting club, League UI, and organization controls.
- Fixed League progression to finish after four matches and separated the neighborhood-front upgrade from the Game Corner slot-tuner upgrade.
- Fixed capture battles so catching Craglet does not end the fight prematurely.
- Added battle creature switching and automatic switch-on-faint so recruited creatures can fight.
- `node --check game.js` passed; manual switching was verified to consume a turn and trigger an opponent attack. An attack also correctly defeated the test opponent and showed the campaign result.

### Active
- Validate automatic replacement after a knockout and continue testing campaign progression, slots/upgrades, daycare/fusion/club, League matches, organization controls, save/load, and responsive presentation.
- Capture and inspect a JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Test automatic replacement after a knockout.
2. Continue validating campaign progression and remaining game features, including save/load and responsive layout.
3. Restore a suitable browser save state, capture and inspect a JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px.
4. Summarize completion and briefly note reasonable assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, campaign, battles, creature roster and switching, League, organization management, and initialization.
- `index.html`: App shell and interactive UI roots.
- `style.css`: Responsive game interface styling.
- `capture.sh`: Invokes the configured capture script.
- `start.sh`: Starts the app using the configured runtime.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files are untracked.
- Browser is at `http://127.0.0.1:3000/`, viewport 1280×900. Its localStorage was replaced with a test save containing Emberkit at 1 HP and Mossbit at 5 HP; reload completed, but the automatic-replacement scenario has not yet been run.
- Manual switch test confirmed Mossbit took over, the League Courier attacked, and Mossbit’s HP decreased. A high-attack test defeated the courier and produced the Dockside result.
- `playwright-cli console` reported a single 404 for `http://127.0.0.1:3000/favicon.ico`.

  request-body <index>        print only the request body for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  response-headers <index>    print only the response headers for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  response-body <index>       print the response body for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command. textual bodies are inlined; binary bodies are saved to a file and the path is printed.

## Objective

- Include 151 Pokémon; all must be fusable and breedable. Fusion must be repeatable indefinitely and yield increasingly better results.
- Capture and inspect a JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px; briefly note reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Use a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with `neon-syndicate-save` as its localStorage key.
- Switching creatures uses the player’s turn; when a creature faints, the next healthy team member takes over automatically.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the game shell, responsive styling, intro and starter selection, campaign progression, battles, recruitment, upgrades, slots, daycare, fusion, fighting club, League UI, and organization controls.

- `node --check game.js` passed; manual switching and automatic replacement were verified.
- Automated campaign playthrough cleared Dockside, Brass Gym, Tidelinе, Market Row, Skyline Gym, and Hilltown, reaching Boss rank.
- Automated all four League matches; confirmed champion status and organization controls appear.

### Active
- Expand the roster and breeding/fusion systems to meet the 151-Pokémon requirement and support unlimited, progressively improving fusion.
- Validate remaining game features, including slots/upgrades, daycare, fusion/club, organization controls, save/load, and responsive presentation.
- Restore a suitable browser save state and capture and inspect a JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect and update `game.js` to implement a 151-creature roster, breeding, and indefinitely repeatable fusion with improving outcomes.
2. Test the new creature and progression systems, then validate remaining gameplay and persistence.
3. Restore a presentable save state, capture and inspect the JPEG screenshot at 1280px or narrower, and summarize completion with brief assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, roster, battles, breeding/fusion, campaign, League, and organization management.
- `index.html`: App shell and interactive UI roots.

- `start.sh`: Starts the app using the configured runtime.

## Objective
- Complete and validate the browser-based pixel RPG about rising through the syndicate and taking over the League.
- Make the League counter track Gym victories, with the Elite Four available only after all eight gyms are beaten.

## Requirements
- Include classic handheld-RPG-inspired battles, recruitment, towns, upgrades, rivals, localStorage saves, playable slots and prizes, daycare, fusion, fighting club, and Boss-rank organization and League management.
- All 151 Pokémon must be breedable and fusable; captured and generated creatures must be usable in battles.
- Elite Four trainers each have six high-level Pokémon.
- Capture and inspect a JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px; briefly note reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Use a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with `neon-syndicate-save` as its localStorage key.
- Switching creatures uses the player’s turn; when a creature faints, the next healthy team member takes over automatically.
- Breeding lets players choose two parents and a species from the 151-Pokémon catalog; fusion consumes two creatures, adds a generation-based stat bonus, and can be repeated.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the game shell, campaign progression, battles, recruitment, upgrades, slots, daycare, fighting club, and organization controls.
- Added breeding and repeatable fusion; the catalog has 151 unique entries ending with `Mew`.
- Added eight Gym stages, three Victory Road stages, four Elite Four parties of six, and a champion party.
- Added versioned League save migration (`leagueVersion:2`), initialized `leagueBadges`, sequential enemy-party combat, League victory rewards, and progression through gyms, Victory Road, Elite Four, champion, and repeatable title defenses.
- Updated League UI to show Gym badge count and gate later stages in order; browser inspection at League counter 7 confirmed the Viridian Gym is ready and later stages await.
- `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` passed; app loads at `http://localhost:3000`.

### Active

1: ## Process lifecycle
2: 
3: - Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.

7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.
18: 
19: ## Mobile browser games
20: 
21: - Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
22: - Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
23: - Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
24: - Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete the browser-based pixel RPG about rising through the syndicate and taking over the League, including Kanto travel and related story/gameplay features.
- Preserve Pokémon’s original types and apply consistent type weaknesses in battle.

## Requirements
- Include battles, recruitment, towns, upgrades, rivals, localStorage saves, playable slots and prizes, daycare, fusion, fighting club, and Boss-rank organization management.
- Make all 151 Pokémon breedable and fusable; captured and generated creatures must be battle-ready.
- Unlock the Elite Four only after all eight gyms and three Victory Road stages; give each Elite Four trainer six high-level Pokémon.
- Locate gyms in their towns; make Safari Zone available from Grunt rank with captures and business income.
- Add random map trainers to battle and steal from.
- Validate gameplay and save migration; capture and inspect a JPEG at a viewport no wider than 1280px; briefly note reasonable assumptions.
- Keep Pokémon’s original types and make type weaknesses consistent.

## Decisions
- Use a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with `neon-syndicate-save` as its localStorage key.
- Switching creatures uses the player’s turn; a healthy teammate automatically takes over when one faints.
- Breeding selects two parents and a species from the 151-Pokémon catalog; fusion consumes two creatures, adds generation-based stats, and can be repeated.
- The rival is Nia Vale; include an early story beat involving stealing her bike.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented the game shell, campaign progression, battles, recruitment, upgrades, slots and prizes, daycare, fighting club, breeding, repeatable fusion, and organization controls.
- Added the 151-species catalog, eight Gym stages, three Victory Road stages, four six-creature Elite Four parties, and a champion party.
- Added versioned League save migration (`leagueVersion:2`), badge tracking, sequential enemy-party combat, rewards, and progression through gyms, Victory Road, Elite Four, champion, and title defenses.
- Added Kanto destinations, town-specific Gym panels, Indigo Plateau and Safari Zone panels, Nia’s bike theft, Safari captures/business claiming, and random local trainer battle/theft interactions.
- Added Safari business income to `workShift()`, trainer UI in `renderField()`, and responsive Kanto/town-panel styles.
- `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` passed.
- Opened the app at `http://127.0.0.1:3000`; intro rendered, with only a missing `/favicon.ico` 404 observed.

### Active
- Correct Pokémon type assignments in `game.js` and implement/verify type-effectiveness logic in battles.
- Test gameplay, Gym access, Safari captures/income, bike story beat, map trainers, and save migration.
- Capture and inspect a JPEG at viewport width ≤1280px; review changes and briefly document assumptions.

### Blocked
- `./start.sh` could not start because port 3000 was already in use (`EADDRINUSE`); the existing server responded successfully at that port.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `TYPE_GROUPS`, `POKEMON` construction, and `battleTurn()` in `game.js`; add accurate original type data and consistent type matchup effects.
2. Run focused gameplay and migration checks, including Safari income and map-trainer battle/theft.
3. Produce and inspect a JPEG screenshot at width ≤1280px, then review the diff and note assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Pokémon catalog/types, battle logic, save migration, Kanto travel, Safari and trainer interactions.
- `style.css`: Kanto travel, town-panel, and responsive styles.
- `index.html`: Game shell and interactive UI roots.
- `capture.sh`: Existing screenshot capture entry point.
- `start.sh`: App startup script.

## Important Context
- Project files are uncommitted and currently untracked.
- The current `POKEMON` builder chooses one type through `TYPE_GROUPS` and defaults unlisted species to `NORMAL`; no type-effectiveness system was found in the initial inspection.
- Existing browser session loaded the intro; gameplay interactions and screenshot validation have not yet been completed.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete the browser-based pixel RPG about rising through the syndicate, traveling across Kanto, and taking over the Pokémon League.
- Preserve Pokémon’s original types and apply consistent type weaknesses in battle.

## Requirements
- Include battles, recruitment, towns, upgrades, rivals, localStorage saves, playable slots and prizes, daycare, fusion, fighting club, and Boss-rank organization management.
- Make all 151 Pokémon breedable and fusable; captured and generated creatures must be battle-ready.
- Unlock the Elite Four only after all eight gyms and three Victory Road stages; give each Elite Four trainer six high-level Pokémon.
- Locate gyms in their towns; make Safari Zone available from Grunt rank with captures and business income.
- Add random map trainers to battle and steal from.
- Validate gameplay and save migration; capture and inspect a JPEG at a viewport no wider than 1280px; briefly note reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Use a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with `neon-syndicate-save` as its localStorage key.
- Switching creatures uses the player’s turn; a healthy teammate automatically takes over when one faints.
- Breeding selects two parents and a species from the 151-Pokémon catalog; fusion consumes two creatures, adds generation-based stats, and can be repeated.
- The rival is Nia Vale; include an early story beat involving stealing her bike.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented the game shell, campaign progression, battles, recruitment, upgrades, slots and prizes, daycare, fighting club, breeding, repeatable fusion, and organization controls.
- Added the 151-species catalog, eight Gym stages, three Victory Road stages, four six-creature Elite Four parties, and a champion party.
- Added versioned League save migration (`leagueVersion:2`), badge tracking, sequential enemy-party combat, rewards, and progression through gyms, Victory Road, Elite Four, champion, and title defenses.
- Added Kanto destinations, town-specific Gym panels, Indigo Plateau and Safari Zone panels, Nia’s bike theft, Safari captures/business claiming, and random local trainer battle/theft interactions.
- Added `TYPE_OVERRIDES`, multi-type Pokémon data, `TYPE_CHART`, and type-effectiveness/damage helpers; connected type-based damage and effectiveness messages to player and enemy attacks in `battleTurn()`.
- `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` passed after the type and battle changes.

### Active
- Verify species type assignments against original Generation I typings and ensure the type chart matches the intended compatibility.
- Test gameplay, Gym access, Safari captures/income, bike story beat, map trainers, and save migration.
- Capture and inspect a JPEG at width ≤1280px; review changes and briefly document assumptions.

### Blocked
- `./start.sh` previously failed because port 3000 was already in use (`EADDRINUSE`); an existing server was responding on that port.

## Next Move
1. Audit `TYPE_OVERRIDES` and matchup rules, especially later-added Fairy/Steel/Dark types versus the original-generation requirement.
2. Run gameplay and save-migration checks, including the requested feature paths.
3. Capture and inspect a JPEG at viewport width ≤1280px, review the project state, and note assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: species catalog and types, battle logic, save migration, Kanto travel, Safari and trainer interactions.
- `style.css`: Kanto travel, town-panel, and responsive styles.
- `index.html`: Game shell and interactive UI roots.
- `capture.sh`: Existing screenshot capture entry point.
- `start.sh`: App startup script.

## Important Context
- Project files are uncommitted and currently untracked.
- `damageWithTypes()` applies STAB for the attacker’s primary type and uses the configured chart against defender types.
- The existing capture script uses the runtime’s default capture flow, which produces desktop 1440×900 and mobile 390×844 PNGs; it does not by itself meet the requested ≤1280px JPEG capture.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete the browser-based pixel RPG about rising through the syndicate, traveling across Kanto, and taking over the Pokémon League.
- Preserve Pokémon’s original types and apply consistent type weaknesses in battle.

## Requirements
- Include battles, recruitment, towns, upgrades, rivals, localStorage saves, playable slots and prizes, daycare, fusion, fighting club, and Boss-rank organization management.
- Make all 151 Pokémon breedable and fusable; captured and generated creatures must be battle-ready.
- Unlock the Elite Four only after all eight gyms and three Victory Road stages; give each Elite Four trainer six high-level Pokémon.
- Locate gyms in their towns; make Safari Zone available from Grunt rank with captures and business income.
- Add random map trainers to battle and steal from.
- Validate gameplay and save migration; capture and inspect a JPEG at a viewport no wider than 1280px; briefly note reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Use a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with `neon-syndicate-save` as its localStorage key.
- Switching creatures uses the player’s turn; a healthy teammate automatically takes over when one faints.
- Breeding selects two parents and a species from the 151-Pokémon catalog; fusion consumes two creatures, adds generation-based stats, and can be repeated.
- The rival is Nia Vale; include an early story beat involving stealing her bike.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented the game shell, campaign progression, battles, recruitment, upgrades, slots and prizes, daycare, fighting club, breeding, repeatable fusion, and organization controls.
- Added the 151-species catalog, eight Gym stages, three Victory Road stages, four six-creature Elite Four parties, and a champion party.
- Added versioned League save migration (`leagueVersion:2`), badge tracking, sequential enemy-party combat, rewards, and progression through gyms, Victory Road, Elite Four, champion, and title defenses.
- Added Kanto destinations, town-specific Gym panels, Indigo Plateau and Safari Zone panels, Nia’s bike theft, Safari captures/business claiming, and random local trainer battle/theft interactions.
- Added type-effectiveness and damage helpers and applied them to player and enemy attacks in `battleTurn()`.
- `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` passed before the latest `TYPE_GROUPS` edit.

### Active
- Finish auditing Generation I species type assignments and matchup compatibility. The latest edit removed Fairy from `TYPE_GROUPS`, but Fairy/Steel/Dark entries remain in `TYPE_OVERRIDES` and `TYPE_CHART`; validate whether typings should follow original Generation I types.
- Run syntax/diff checks after the latest edit, then test gameplay and save migration, including League access, Safari, bike story beat, and map trainers.
- Capture and inspect a JPEG at width ≤1280px; review changes and briefly document assumptions.

### Blocked
- `./start.sh` previously failed because port 3000 was already in use (`EADDRINUSE`); an existing server was responding on that port.

## Next Move
1. Audit `TYPE_OVERRIDES`, `TYPE_GROUPS`, and `TYPE_CHART` against the requested original Pokémon typings and chosen type compatibility.
2. Run `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check`; validate gameplay and save migration.
3. Produce and inspect a JPEG screenshot at viewport width ≤1280px, review the project state, and note assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Species catalog and types, battle logic, save migration, Kanto travel, Safari and trainer interactions.
- `style.css`: Kanto travel, town-panel, and responsive styles.
- `index.html`: Game shell and interactive UI roots.
- `capture.sh`: Existing screenshot capture entry point; default flow captures PNGs at 1440×900 and 390×844, not the requested JPEG.
- `start.sh`: App startup script.
- `/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime/scripts/default-capture.mjs`: Existing Playwright capture flow and viewport settings.

## Important Context
- Project files are uncommitted and currently untracked.
- Recent successful checks predate the latest `TYPE_GROUPS` change.
- `damageWithTypes()` applies STAB for the attacker’s primary type and uses the configured chart against defender types.

import { startForCapture } from './capture-start.mjs'
import captures from './wip-screenshots.cjs'
import { createRequire } from 'node:module'
import { readFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
const runtime = join(process.env.HOME, '.local/share/omgithub-playwright')
const require = createRequire(join(runtime, 'package.json'))
const { chromium } = require('playwright')
captures.instrument({ chromium })
const config = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(runtime, process.platform === 'darwin' ? 'metal.json' : 'linux.json'), 'utf8'))
if (process.platform === 'linux') process.env.DISPLAY ||= ':' + readFileSync(join(runtime, 'display'), 'utf8').trim()
const url = process.env.CAPTURE_URL, output = process.env.CAPTURE_DIR
if (!url || !output) throw new Error('Set CAPTURE_URL and CAPTURE_DIR.')
mkdirSync(output, { recursive: true })
const transient = error => { throw Object.assign(error, { exitCode: 75 }) }
let browser
try {
  browser = await chromium.launch({ ...config.browser.launchOptions, timeout: 30000 }).catch(transient)
  for (const [name, width, height] of [['desktop', 1440, 900], ['mobile', 390, 844]]) {
    const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width, height } }).catch(transient)
    page.setDefaultTimeout(30000)
    const failures = []
    page.on('pageerror', error => { console.error(error.message); failures.push(error.message) })
    page.on('response', response => { if (response.status() >= 400 && new URL(response.url()).origin === new URL(url).origin) failures.push(`HTTP ${response.status()}: ${response.url()}`) })
    const response = await page.goto(url, { waitUntil: 'load', timeout: 45000 }).catch(transient)
    if (!response?.ok()) throw Object.assign(new Error(`HTTP ${response?.status()} loading preview`), { exitCode: !response || [408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504].includes(response.status()) ? 75 : 1 })
    await page.locator(process.env.CAPTURE_READY_SELECTOR || 'body').waitFor({ state: 'visible' })
    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.fonts.status === 'loaded')
    const start = await startForCapture(page, {
      enabled: process.env.CAPTURE_AUTO_START !== 'false',
      selector: process.env.CAPTURE_START_SELECTOR || ''
    })
    console.log(`Capture ${name}: auto-start ${start.clicked ? 'clicked' : start.reason}`)
    await page.waitForTimeout(1000)
    await page.screenshot({ path: join(output, `final-${name}.png`), timeout: 30000 }).catch(error => {
      if (error.name === 'TimeoutError' || !browser.isConnected()) transient(error)
      throw error
    })
    if (process.env.CAPTURE_STRICT === '1' && failures.length) throw new Error(`Published build failed: ${failures.join('; ')}`)
    await page.close()
  }
} catch (error) { console.error(error); process.exitCode = error.exitCode || 1 }
finally { await browser?.close().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode ||= 75 }) }

## Objective
- Complete the browser-based pixel RPG about rising through the syndicate, traveling across Kanto, and taking over the Pokémon League.
- Preserve Generation I Pokémon types and apply consistent type weaknesses in battle.

## Requirements
- Include battles, recruitment, towns, upgrades, rivals, localStorage saves, playable slots and prizes, daycare, fusion, fighting club, and Boss-rank organization management.
- Make all 151 Pokémon breedable and fusable; captured and generated creatures must be battle-ready.
- Unlock the Elite Four only after all eight gyms and three Victory Road stages; give each Elite Four trainer six high-level Pokémon.

- Add random map trainers to battle and steal from.

- Use a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with `neon-syndicate-save` as its localStorage key.
- Switching creatures uses the player’s turn; a healthy teammate automatically takes over when one faints.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete and validate the browser-based pixel RPG about rising through the syndicate, traveling across Kanto, and taking over the Pokémon League.
- Finish Pokémon-specific equipment and player gear slots, then validate gameplay/save migration and inspect a JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Include battles, recruitment, towns, upgrades, rivals, localStorage saves, playable slots and prizes, daycare, fusion, fighting club, and Boss-rank organization management.
- Make all 151 Pokémon breedable and fusable; captured and generated creatures must be battle-ready.
- Unlock the Elite Four only after all eight gyms and three Victory Road stages; each Elite Four trainer must have six high-level Pokémon.
- Locate gyms in their towns; make Safari Zone available from Grunt rank with captures and business income.
- Add random map trainers to battle and steal from.
- Validate gameplay and save migration; capture and inspect a JPEG at viewport width ≤1280px; briefly note reasonable assumptions.
- Each Pokémon can equip one Pokémon-specific item; player slots: hats, shirts, pants, gloves, shoes, and two accessories.

## Decisions
- Use a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with `neon-syndicate-save` as its localStorage key.
- Switching creatures uses the player’s turn; a healthy teammate automatically takes over when one faints.
- Breeding selects two parents and a species from the 151-Pokémon catalog; fusion consumes two creatures, adds generation-based stats, and can be repeated.
- The rival is Nia Vale; include an early story beat involving stealing her bike.
- Use original Generation I type assignments; exclude Fairy and later-generation Steel/Dark interactions from the type chart.
- Player gear bonuses are attack, defense, and max HP.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented game shell, campaign progression, battles, recruitment, upgrades, slots and prizes, daycare, fighting club, breeding, repeatable fusion, and organization controls.
- Added the 151-species catalog, eight Gym stages, three Victory Road stages, four six-creature Elite Four parties, and a champion party.
- Added League progression/save migration (`leagueVersion:2`), badge tracking, sequential enemy-party combat, rewards, and progression through gyms, Victory Road, Elite Four, champion, and title defenses.
- Added Kanto destinations, town-specific Gym panels, Indigo Plateau and Safari Zone panels, Nia’s bike theft, Safari captures/business claiming, and random local trainer battle/theft interactions.
- Updated Generation I typings in `TYPE_OVERRIDES` and `TYPE_CHART`; `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` passed.
- Added `PLAYER_SLOTS`, `GEAR`, and `EMPTY_EQUIPMENT` definitions in `game.js`.
- Confirmed the app responds at `http://localhost:3000/`; inspected `screenshots/neon-syndicate.jpg`, which is a 1280×965 JPEG.

### Active
- Complete equipment UI, gameplay effects, ownership/equip actions, save persistence/migration, and validation.
- Run `/tmp/opencode/validate-game.mjs`; investigate the absent `#steal-bike` selector after travel to Cerulean City and fix the implementation or test.
- Verify screenshot content and dimensions, gameplay and migration, then note reasonable assumptions.

### Blocked
- Validation is blocked by a timeout waiting for `#steal-bike` after traveling to Cerulean City; root cause remains uninvestigated.

## Next Move
1. Implement equipment UI, effects, ownership/equip behavior, and persistence/migration in `game.js`, `index.html`, and `style.css`.
2. Run `/tmp/opencode/validate-game.mjs`; investigate and resolve the missing `#steal-bike` selector after traveling to Cerulean City.
3. Verify screenshot dimensions/content, gameplay and save migration; report reasonable assumptions and validation results.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, save migration, catalog, travel, battles, League, and in-progress gear definitions.
- `index.html`: Game shell and interactive UI roots.
- `style.css`: Layout, panels, and responsive styling.
- `/tmp/opencode/validate-game.mjs`: Playwright validation script.
- `screenshots/neon-syndicate.jpg`: Existing screenshot to inspect.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files were untracked in the last status output.
- An earlier `./start.sh` attempt failed with `EADDRINUSE`; the app was already serving HTTP 200 on port 3000.
- The validator captures at `{width:1280,height:960}` and checks Safari capture, income, League gating/parties, and migration.

- Complete and validate the browser-based pixel RPG about rising through the syndicate, traveling across Kanto, and taking over the Pokémon League.
- Finish Pokémon-specific equipment and player gear slots, then validate gameplay/save migration and inspect a JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Include battles, recruitment, towns, upgrades, rivals, localStorage saves, playable slots and prizes, daycare, fusion, fighting club, and Boss-rank organization management.
- Make all 151 Pokémon breedable and fusable; captured and generated creatures must be battle-ready.
- Unlock the Elite Four only after all eight gyms and three Victory Road stages; each Elite Four trainer must have six high-level Pokémon.
- Locate gyms in their towns; make Safari Zone available from Grunt rank with captures and business income.
- Add random map trainers to battle and steal from.
- Validate gameplay and save migration; capture and inspect a JPEG at viewport width ≤1280px; briefly note reasonable assumptions.
- Each Pokémon can equip one Pokémon-specific item; player slots: hats, shirts, pants, gloves, shoes, and two accessories.

## Decisions
- Use a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with `neon-syndicate-save` as its localStorage key.
- Switching creatures uses the player’s turn; a healthy teammate automatically takes over when one faints.
- Breeding selects two parents and a species from the 151-Pokémon catalog; fusion consumes two creatures, adds generation-based stats, and can be repeated.
- The rival is Nia Vale; include an early story beat involving stealing her bike.
- Use original Generation I type assignments; exclude Fairy and later-generation Steel/Dark interactions from the type chart.
- Player gear bonuses are attack, defense, and max HP.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented game shell, campaign progression, battles, recruitment, upgrades, slots and prizes, daycare, fighting club, breeding, repeatable fusion, and organization controls.
- Added the 151-species catalog, eight Gym stages, three Victory Road stages, four six-creature Elite Four parties, and a champion party.
- Added League progression/save migration (`leagueVersion:2`), badge tracking, sequential enemy-party combat, rewards, and progression through gyms, Victory Road, Elite Four, champion, and title defenses.
- Added Kanto destinations, town-specific Gym panels, Indigo Plateau and Safari Zone panels, Nia’s bike theft, Safari captures/business claiming, and random local trainer battle/theft interactions.
- Updated Generation I typings in `TYPE_OVERRIDES` and `TYPE_CHART`; `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` passed.
- Added `PLAYER_SLOTS`, `GEAR`, and `EMPTY_EQUIPMENT` definitions in `game.js`.
- Confirmed the app responds at `http://localhost:3000/`; inspected `screenshots/neon-syndicate.jpg`, a 1280×965 JPEG.

### Active
- Complete equipment UI, gameplay effects, ownership/equip actions, save persistence/migration, and validation.
- Run `/tmp/opencode/validate-game.mjs`; investigate the absent `#steal-bike` selector after travel to Cerulean City and fix the implementation or test.
- Verify screenshot content and dimensions, gameplay and migration, then note reasonable assumptions.

### Blocked
- Validator times out waiting for `#steal-bike` after traveling to Cerulean City; root cause remains uninvestigated.

## Next Move
1. Implement equipment UI, effects, ownership/equip behavior, and persistence/migration in `game.js`, `index.html`, and `style.css`.
2. Run `/tmp/opencode/validate-game.mjs`; investigate and resolve the missing `#steal-bike` selector after traveling to Cerulean City.
3. Verify screenshot dimensions/content, gameplay and migration; report reasonable assumptions and validation results.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, save migration, catalog, travel, battles, League, and in-progress gear definitions.
- `index.html`: Game shell and interactive UI roots.
- `style.css`: Layout, panels, and responsive styling.
- `/tmp/opencode/validate-game.mjs`: Playwright validation script.
- `screenshots/neon-syndicate.jpg`: Existing screenshot to inspect.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files were untracked in the last status output.
- An earlier `./start.sh` attempt failed with `EADDRINUSE`; the app was already serving HTTP 200 on port 3000.
- The validator captures at `{width:1280,height:960}` and checks Safari capture, income, League gating/parties, and migration.

## Objective
- Complete and validate the browser-based pixel RPG about rising through the syndicate, traveling across Kanto, and taking over the Pokémon League.
- Finish Pokémon-specific equipment and player gear slots, then validate gameplay/save migration and inspect a JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Include battles, recruitment, towns, upgrades, rivals, localStorage saves, playable slots and prizes, daycare, fusion, fighting club, and Boss-rank organization management.
- Make all 151 Pokémon breedable and fusable; captured and generated creatures must be battle-ready.
- Unlock the Elite Four only after all eight gyms and three Victory Road stages; each Elite Four trainer must have six high-level Pokémon.
- Locate gyms in their towns; make Safari Zone available from Grunt rank with captures and business income.
- Add random map trainers to battle and steal from.
- Validate gameplay and save migration; capture and inspect a JPEG at viewport width ≤1280px; briefly note reasonable assumptions.
- Each Pokémon can equip one Pokémon-specific item; player slots: hats, shirts, pants, gloves, shoes, and two accessories.

## Decisions
- Use a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with `neon-syndicate-save` as its localStorage key.
- Switching creatures uses the player’s turn; a healthy teammate automatically takes over when one faints.
- Breeding selects two parents and a species from the 151-Pokémon catalog; fusion consumes two creatures, adds generation-based stats, and can be repeated.
- The rival is Nia Vale; include an early story beat involving stealing her bike.
- Use original Generation I type assignments; exclude Fairy and later-generation Steel/Dark interactions from the type chart.
- Player gear bonuses are attack, defense, and max HP.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented game shell, campaign progression, battles, recruitment, upgrades, slots and prizes, daycare, fighting club, breeding, repeatable fusion, and organization controls.
- Added the 151-species catalog, eight Gym stages, three Victory Road stages, four six-creature Elite Four parties, and a champion party.
- Added League progression/save migration (`leagueVersion:2`), badge tracking, sequential enemy-party combat, rewards, and progression through gyms, Victory Road, Elite Four, champion, and title defenses.
- Added Kanto destinations, town-specific Gym panels, Indigo Plateau and Safari Zone panels, Nia’s bike theft, Safari captures/business claiming, and random local trainer battle/theft interactions.

### Active
- Implement equipment UI, gameplay effects, ownership/equip actions, save persistence/migration in `game.js`, `index.html`, and `style.css`.
- Diagnose validator’s failure to find `#steal-bike` after traveling to Cerulean City.
- Run `/tmp/opencode/validate-game.mjs`, verify screenshot dimensions/content, and validate gameplay and save migration.

### Blocked
- Validator times out waiting for `#steal-bike` after travel to Cerulean City; root cause has not been investigated.

## Next Move
1. Add player and Pokémon gear ownership/equip UI and apply gear bonuses to gameplay; persist and migrate equipment saves.
2. Investigate why Cerulean’s `#steal-bike` notice/button is missing in the validator’s flow.
3. Run `/tmp/opencode/validate-game.mjs`, inspect the JPEG, and confirm gameplay and save migration; briefly report reasonable assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, save migration, catalog, travel, battles, League, and in-progress gear definitions.
- `index.html`: Game shell and interactive UI roots.
- `style.css`: Layout, panels, and responsive styling.
- `/tmp/opencode/validate-game.mjs`: Playwright validation script.
- `screenshots/neon-syndicate.jpg`: Existing screenshot to inspect.

## Important Context
- Project files are uncommitted and were untracked in the last status output.
- `game.js` currently validates syntactically; app responds at `http://localhost:3000/`.
- Validator flow travels to Cerulean City, clicks `#steal-bike`, tests trainers/Safari income/League gating and party sizes, then checks migration from `leagueVersion:1` (`league:4`) to version 2 (`league:16`).

## Objective
- Complete and validate the browser-based pixel RPG, including usable player and Pokémon gear.
- Make Nia’s stolen bike usable after acquisition, with use restricted to outdoors and caves.

## Requirements
- Include battles, recruitment, Kanto towns and gyms, upgrades, rivals, localStorage saves, playable slots and prizes, daycare, fusion, fighting club, and Boss-rank organization management.
- All 151 Pokémon must be breedable and fusable; captured/generated creatures must be battle-ready.
- Elite Four requires eight badges and three Victory Road stages; each Elite Four trainer has six high-level Pokémon.
- Safari Zone opens at Grunt rank with captures and business income; random map trainers can be battled and stolen from.
- Pokémon equipment: one Pokémon-specific item per creature; player slots: hat, shirt, pants, gloves, shoes, and two accessories.
- Inspect a JPEG screenshot at viewport width ≤1280px and briefly note reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Use a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with localStorage key `neon-syndicate-save`.
- Switching creatures uses the player’s turn; a healthy teammate automatically takes over when one faints.
- Breeding selects two parents and a species from the 151-Pokémon catalog; fusion consumes two creatures, adds generation-based stats, and can be repeated.
- Rival is Nia Vale; the story includes stealing her bike.
- Use Generation I type assignments and interactions; player gear bonuses are attack, defense, and max HP.
- Bike use must be available outdoors and in caves, but not inside buildings.

### Completed
- Implemented the game shell, campaign progression, battles, recruitment, upgrades, slots and prizes, daycare, fighting club, breeding, repeatable fusion, organization controls, and save migration (`leagueVersion:2`).

### Active
- Fix Cerulean rendering so the bike event can appear alongside its Gym panel; current Gym branch suppresses the event and validator times out on `#steal-bike`.
- Add bike use with a meaningful travel benefit, restricted to outdoor/cave locations and unavailable in buildings.

- Run `/tmp/opencode/validate-game.mjs`, validate gameplay/save migration, and inspect/update the JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Validator cannot reach the bike-theft interaction at Cerulean because the Gym rendering branch hides the bike feature; render the event alongside the Gym panel.

1. Render the Cerulean bike event without hiding the Gym panel.
2. Implement bike-use action, location eligibility (outdoors and caves only), and travel benefit.

- `index.html`: Game shell and interactive UI roots.
- `style.css`: Layout and responsive styling.
- `/tmp/opencode/validate-game.mjs`: Playwright validation script.
- `screenshots/neon-syndicate.jpg`: Existing screenshot to inspect/update.

## Objective
- Complete and validate the browser-based pixel RPG, including usable player and Pokémon gear.
- Make Nia’s stolen bike usable outdoors and in caves, but not inside buildings, with a meaningful travel benefit.

## Requirements
- Include battles, recruitment, Kanto towns and gyms, upgrades, rivals, localStorage saves, playable slots and prizes, daycare, fusion, fighting club, and Boss-rank organization management.
- All 151 Pokémon must be breedable and fusable; captured/generated creatures must be battle-ready.
- Elite Four requires eight badges and three Victory Road stages; each Elite Four trainer has six high-level Pokémon.
- Safari Zone opens at Grunt rank with captures and business income; random map trainers can be battled and stolen from.
- Pokémon equipment: one Pokémon-specific item per creature; player slots: hat, shirt, pants, gloves, shoes, and two accessories.
- Inspect a JPEG screenshot at viewport width ≤1280px and briefly note reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Use a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with localStorage key `neon-syndicate-save`.
- Switching creatures uses the player’s turn; a healthy teammate automatically takes over when one faints.
- Breeding selects two parents and a species from the 151-Pokémon catalog; fusion consumes two creatures, adds generation-based stats, and can be repeated.
- Rival is Nia Vale; the story includes stealing her bike.
- Use Generation I type assignments and interactions; player gear bonuses are attack, defense, and max HP.
- Bike use must be available outdoors and in caves, but not inside buildings.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented game shell, campaign progression, battles, recruitment, upgrades, slots and prizes, daycare, fighting club, breeding, repeatable fusion, organization controls, and save migration (`leagueVersion:2`).
- Added 151-species catalog, eight Gym stages, three Victory Road stages, six-creature Elite Four parties and champion party.
- Added Kanto destinations, Gym panels, League and Safari panels, bike-theft state, Safari captures/business, and random local trainer interactions.
- Added `equipment` to initial save data and normalized/migrated equipment state, including player slots, Pokémon items, and inventory.

### Active
- Render Cerulean’s bike event alongside its Gym panel; current Gym rendering branch suppresses the event.
- Add bike-use action, location eligibility (outdoors and caves only), and travel benefit.
- Implement equipment shop/inventory/equip UI and apply gear bonuses in battles across `game.js`, `index.html`, and `style.css`.
- Run `/tmp/opencode/validate-game.mjs`, validate gameplay/save migration, and inspect/update `screenshots/neon-syndicate.jpg`.

### Blocked
- Validator cannot reach the bike-theft interaction at Cerulean because the Gym rendering branch hides the bike feature; render the event alongside the Gym panel.

## Next Move
1. Render Cerulean’s bike event without hiding the Gym panel.
2. Implement bike-use action, location eligibility, and travel benefit.
3. Implement equipment shop/inventory/equip UI and combat bonuses.
4. Run `/tmp/opencode/validate-game.mjs`, test save migration and gameplay, and inspect the JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, gear definitions, save migration, travel, bike event, and combat.
- `index.html`: Game shell and interactive UI roots.
- `style.css`: Layout and responsive styling.
- `/tmp/opencode/validate-game.mjs`: Playwright validation script.
- `screenshots/neon-syndicate.jpg`: Existing screenshot to inspect/update.

## Important Context
- Project files are untracked; no commit or push was reported.
- Bike state uses `state.bikeStolen`; `stealNiasBike()` sets it, but travel has no cost or bike-dependent behavior yet.
- `EMPTY_EQUIPMENT` includes `{player, pokemon, inventory}` and load logic normalizes equipment against valid gear IDs.
- `renderField()` currently assigns only the Gym feature when the current town has a Gym, so Cerulean’s bike event does not render.
- Validator expects Cerulean `#steal-bike`, trainer interactions, Safari capture/income, League gating/parties, and migration from `leagueVersion:1` (`league:4`) to version 2 (`league:16`).

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete and validate the browser-based pixel RPG, including usable gear, bike travel, and Kanto towns with source-inspired services and distinct content.

## Requirements
- Include battles, recruitment, Kanto towns and gyms, upgrades, rivals, localStorage saves, playable slots and prizes, daycare, fusion, fighting club, and Boss-rank organization management.
- All 151 Pokémon must be breedable and fusable; captured/generated creatures must be battle-ready.
- Elite Four requires eight badges and three Victory Road stages; each Elite Four trainer has six high-level Pokémon.
- Safari Zone opens at Grunt rank with captures and business income; random map trainers can be battled and stolen from.
- Pokémon equipment: one Pokémon-specific item per creature; player slots: hat, shirt, pants, gloves, shoes, and two accessories.
- Bike use must be available outdoors and in caves, but not inside buildings, with a meaningful travel benefit.
- Towns should match their source material with healing centers, Pokémarts, and town-specific content.
- Inspect a JPEG screenshot at viewport width ≤1280px and briefly note reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Use a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with localStorage key `neon-syndicate-save`.
- Switching creatures uses the player’s turn; a healthy teammate automatically takes over when one faints.
- Breeding selects two parents and a species from the 151-Pokémon catalog; fusion consumes two creatures, adds generation-based stats, and can be repeated.
- Rival is Nia Vale; the story includes stealing her bike.
- Use Generation I type assignments and interactions; player gear bonuses are attack, defense, and max HP.
- Existing bike theft event says Kanto travel becomes free, but actual bike-use behavior remains unimplemented.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented game shell, campaign progression, battles, recruitment, upgrades, slots and prizes, daycare, fighting club, breeding, repeatable fusion, organization controls, and save migration (`leagueVersion:2`).
- Added 151-species catalog, eight Gym stages, three Victory Road stages, six-creature Elite Four parties and champion party.
- Added Kanto destinations, Gym panels, League and Safari panels, bike-theft state, Safari captures/business, and random local trainer interactions.
- Added gear definitions, seven player slots, Pokémon equipment mapping, inventory, and save normalization/migration.

### Active
- Add bike-use UI/action with eligibility limited to outdoors and caves, and a travel benefit.
- Build equipment shopping, inventory, and equip UI; integrate player and Pokémon gear bonuses into combat across `game.js`, `index.html`, and `style.css`.
- Add source-inspired town services (healing centers and Pokémarts) and distinct town-specific content.
- Run `/tmp/opencode/validate-game.mjs`, validate gameplay/save migration, and inspect/update `screenshots/neon-syndicate.jpg`.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add town-specific service/content panels, including healing centers and Pokémarts, and connect their actions to game state and credits.
2. Add bike-use UI/action, restricting use to outdoors and caves while providing a meaningful travel benefit.
3. Build equipment shopping, inventory, and equip UI; apply player and Pokémon gear bonuses in combat.
4. Run `/tmp/opencode/validate-game.mjs`, test gameplay and save migration, and inspect the JPEG screenshot at ≤1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, gear definitions, save migration, travel, bike event, town rendering, and combat.
- `index.html`: Game shell and interactive UI roots.
- `style.css`: Layout and responsive styling.
- `/tmp/opencode/validate-game.mjs`: Playwright validation script.
- `screenshots/neon-syndicate.jpg`: Existing screenshot to inspect/update.

## Important Context
- Bike theft is implemented by `stealNiasBike()` in `game.js`; it sets `state.bikeStolen=true`, saves, renders, and reports “Kanto travel is now free.”
- `renderField()` builds town features and destination travel controls; the current town model includes gym destinations, Safari Zone, Indigo Plateau, and field offices.
- Validator expects Cerulean `#steal-bike`, trainer interactions, Safari capture/income, League gating/parties, and migration from `leagueVersion:1` (`league:4`) to version 2 (`league:16`).
- Changes are uncommitted; project files are untracked.

## Objective
- Complete and validate the browser-based pixel RPG, including usable gear, bike travel, and Kanto towns with source-inspired services and distinct content.

## Requirements
- Include battles, recruitment, Kanto towns and gyms, upgrades, rivals, localStorage saves, playable slots and prizes, daycare, fusion, fighting club, and Boss-rank organization management.
- All 151 Pokémon must be breedable and fusable; captured/generated creatures must be battle-ready.
- Elite Four requires eight badges and three Victory Road stages; each Elite Four trainer has six high-level Pokémon.
- Safari Zone opens at Grunt rank with captures and business income; random map trainers can be battled and stolen from.
- Pokémon equipment: one Pokémon-specific item per creature; player slots: hat, shirt, pants, gloves, shoes, and two accessories.
- Bike use must be available outdoors and in caves, but not inside buildings, with a meaningful travel benefit.
- Towns should match their source material with healing centers, Pokémarts, and town-specific content.
- Inspect a JPEG screenshot at viewport width ≤1280px and briefly note reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Use a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with localStorage key `neon-syndicate-save`.
- Switching creatures uses the player’s turn; a healthy teammate automatically takes over when one faints.
- Breeding selects two parents and a species from the 151-Pokémon catalog; fusion consumes two creatures, adds generation-based stats, and can be repeated.
- Rival is Nia Vale; the story includes stealing her bike.
- Use Generation I type assignments and interactions; player gear bonuses are attack, defense, and max HP.
- Existing bike theft event says Kanto travel becomes free, but bike-use behavior remains unimplemented.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented game shell, campaign progression, battles, recruitment, upgrades, slots and prizes, daycare, fighting club, breeding, repeatable fusion, organization controls, and save migration (`leagueVersion:2`).
- Added 151-species catalog, eight Gym stages, three Victory Road stages, six-creature Elite Four parties and champion party.
- Added Kanto destinations, Gym panels, League and Safari panels, bike-theft state, Safari captures/business, and random local trainer interactions.
- Added gear definitions, seven player slots, Pokémon equipment mapping, inventory, and save normalization/migration.

### Active
- Add source-inspired town services (healing centers and Pokémarts) and distinct town-specific content.
- Add bike-use UI/action, restricting use to outdoors and caves while providing a meaningful travel benefit.
- Build equipment shopping, inventory, and equip UI; apply player and Pokémon gear bonuses in combat.
- Run `/tmp/opencode/validate-game.mjs`, test gameplay/save migration, and inspect/update `screenshots/neon-syndicate.jpg`.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add town-specific service/content panels, including healing centers and Pokémarts, and connect their actions to game state and credits.
2. Add bike-use UI/action, restricting use to outdoors and caves while providing a meaningful travel benefit.
3. Build equipment shopping, inventory, and equip UI; apply player and Pokémon gear bonuses in combat.
4. Run `/tmp/opencode/validate-game.mjs`, test gameplay and save migration, and inspect the JPEG screenshot at ≤1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, gear definitions, save migration, travel, bike event, town rendering, and combat.
- `index.html`: Game shell and interactive UI roots.
- `style.css`: Layout and responsive styling.
- `/tmp/opencode/validate-game.mjs`: Playwright validation script.
- `screenshots/neon-syndicate.jpg`: Existing screenshot to inspect/update.

## Important Context
- Bike theft is implemented by `stealNiasBike()` in `game.js`; it sets `state.bikeStolen=true`, saves, renders, and reports “Kanto travel is now free.”
- `renderField()` builds town features and destination travel controls; Kanto destinations currently switch immediately through `data-travel` buttons.
- The bike currently affects only route-board messaging; there is no bike-use action, travel restriction, or travel benefit implemented.
- Gear data and migration exist, but no shopping/equip interface or combat bonuses are wired up.
- Validator expects Cerulean `#steal-bike`, trainer interactions, Safari capture/income, League gating/parties, and migration from `leagueVersion:1` (`league:4`) to version 2 (`league:16`).
- Work is uncommitted; project files are untracked.

## Requirements
- Include battles, recruitment, Kanto towns and gyms, upgrades, rivals, localStorage saves, playable slots and prizes, daycare, fusion, fighting club, and Boss-rank organization management.
- All 151 Pokémon must be breedable and fusable; captured/generated creatures must be battle-ready.
- Elite Four requires eight badges and three Victory Road stages; each Elite Four trainer has six high-level Pokémon.
- Safari Zone opens at Grunt rank with captures and business income; random map trainers can be battled and stolen from.
- Pokémon equipment: one Pokémon-specific item per creature; player slots: hat, shirt, pants, gloves, shoes, and two accessories.
- Bike use must be available outdoors and in caves, but not inside buildings, with a meaningful travel benefit.
- Towns should match their source material with healing centers, Pokémarts, and town-specific content.
- Inspect a JPEG screenshot at viewport width ≤1280px and briefly note reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Use a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with localStorage key `neon-syndicate-save`.
- Switching creatures uses the player’s turn; a healthy teammate automatically takes over when one faints.
- Breeding selects two parents and a species from the 151-Pokémon catalog; fusion consumes two creatures, adds generation-based stats, and can be repeated.
- Rival is Nia Vale; the story includes stealing her bike.
- Use Generation I type assignments and interactions; player gear bonuses are attack, defense, and max HP.
- Existing bike theft event says Kanto travel becomes free, but bike-use behavior remains unimplemented.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete and validate the browser-based pixel RPG with usable gear, bike travel, and Kanto towns featuring source-inspired services and distinct content.

## Requirements
- Include battles, recruitment, Kanto towns and gyms, upgrades, rivals, localStorage saves, playable slots and prizes, daycare, fusion, fighting club, and Boss-rank organization management.
- All 151 Pokémon must be breedable and fusable; captured/generated creatures must be battle-ready.
- Elite Four requires eight badges and three Victory Road stages; each Elite Four trainer has six high-level Pokémon.
- Safari Zone opens at Grunt rank with captures and business income; random map trainers can be battled and stolen from.
- Pokémon equipment: one Pokémon-specific item per creature; player slots: hat, shirt, pants, gloves, shoes, and two accessories.
- Bike use must be available outdoors and in caves, but not inside buildings, with a meaningful travel benefit.
- Towns should match their source material with healing centers, Pokémarts, and town-specific content.
- Inspect a JPEG screenshot at viewport width ≤1280px and briefly note reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Use a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with localStorage key `neon-syndicate-save`.
- Switching creatures uses the player’s turn; a healthy teammate automatically takes over when one faints.
- Breeding selects two parents and a species from the 151-Pokémon catalog; fusion consumes two creatures, adds generation-based stats, and can be repeated.
- Rival is Nia Vale; the story includes stealing her bike.
- Use Generation I type assignments and interactions; player gear bonuses are attack, defense, and max HP.
- Existing bike theft event says Kanto travel becomes free, but bike-use behavior remains unimplemented.

## Work State

### Completed
- Implemented game shell, campaign progression, battles, recruitment, upgrades, slots and prizes, daycare, fighting club, breeding, repeatable fusion, organization controls, and save migration (`leagueVersion:2`).
- Added 151-species catalog, eight Gym stages, three Victory Road stages, six-creature Elite Four parties and champion party.
- Added Kanto destinations, Gym panels, League and Safari panels, bike-theft state, Safari captures/business, and random local trainer interactions.
- Added gear definitions, seven player slots, Pokémon equipment mapping, inventory, and save normalization/migration.

### Active
- Add town-specific service/content panels, including healing centers and Pokémarts, and connect their actions to game state and credits.
- Add bike-use UI/action, restricting use to outdoors and caves while providing a meaningful travel benefit.
- Build equipment shopping, inventory, and equip UI; apply player and Pokémon gear bonuses in combat.
- Run `/tmp/opencode/validate-game.mjs`, test gameplay/save migration, and inspect/update `screenshots/neon-syndicate.jpg` at ≤1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add town-specific services and content, including healing centers and Pokémarts, with functioning actions and credit costs.
2. Implement bike-use UI/action for outdoor and cave travel, unavailable inside buildings, with a meaningful benefit.
3. Build equipment shopping/inventory/equip UI and apply gear bonuses in combat.
4. Run `/tmp/opencode/validate-game.mjs`, test gameplay and save migration, and inspect/update the JPEG screenshot at ≤1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, gear definitions, save migration, travel, bike event, town rendering, and combat.
- `index.html`: Game shell and interactive UI roots.
- `style.css`: Layout and responsive styling.
- `/tmp/opencode/validate-game.mjs`: Playwright validation script.
- `screenshots/neon-syndicate.jpg`: Existing screenshot to inspect/update.

## Important Context
- Bike theft is implemented by `stealNiasBike()` in `game.js`; it sets `state.bikeStolen=true`, saves, renders, and reports “Kanto travel is now free.”
- `renderField()` builds town features and destination travel controls; Kanto destinations currently switch immediately through `data-travel` buttons.
- The bike currently affects only route-board messaging; there is no bike-use action, travel restriction, or travel benefit implemented.
- Gear data and migration exist, but no shopping/equip interface or combat bonuses are wired up.
- Validator expects Cerulean `#steal-bike`, trainer interactions, Safari capture/income, League gating/parties, and migration from `leagueVersion:1` (`league:4`) to version 2 (`league:16`).
- Changes are uncommitted; project files are untracked.
